scope: Diagnostic only; uses simulator truth to audit matching and to supply ideal correspondences. No image-only accuracy claim.

match_audit.visibility_test: both depth projections consistent within max(1 mm,1% Z), source local depth spread <= max(1 mm,2% Z)
match_audit.classification: 2 px bidirectional distance is a diagnostic tolerance; depth resampling and finite blur limit exact feature correspondence at boundaries.
